Package hadur2.core

Class Archive

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.Archive
final class Archive extends Object
The conductor's facade over memory (A4): it hands each brain its shelf, or none, by charter, behind one gate on the store's writes and deletes.
  • A shelf belongs to one strand: the .hp profiles and the battle clock to the Duel, the .hm blocks to Melee and the .ht blocks to Team. Anything else, the health record, is the conductor's.
  • SHELF-3: a shelf is written only in its own charter's battle, so a melee writes no .hp file and a team battle neither .hp nor .hm. Any shelf may be read in any charter: the melee hand-off reads the survivor's .hp profile.
  • SHELF-1: a shelf is written only on behalf of its own strand's role, which the gate enforces by file name whoever asks.
  • SHELF-2: in a team battle only the leader, the team's scribe fixed at tick 0, writes or deletes anything, the health record included: five members share one data directory, and each counts its own quota.
